name: obscura-aleo-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for Obscura — privacy-first sealed-bid auction protocol on Aleo. 10 auction formats (Sealed, Vickrey, Dutch, English, Bundle, Multi-Unit, Candle, Reverse, Blind Dutch, Timed Escalation). Points to core_v4 + settle_v6: commit-based settlements, BidderParticipationProof + AuctionCompletionProof records, reputation counter removed, post-settle cleanup.
author: Obscura
